reviews.text: I really like this store for my dog's chews. They are natural, original, very varied, in bulk, you can't find them anywhere else. My dog ​​eats them up. They have promotions for regular customers. Highly, highly recommended.

I went to buy some products for my dogs. Most of them don't have prices printed on them, and you have to use a barcode scanner that doesn't work very well to find out the price.
The worst part is that I bought some ID tags that the saleswoman told me cost €6, but when I checked the receipt, it came to €8, and then to my surprise, they don't tell you the price including VAT. So it costs much more than they tell you.
I feel cheated.

This store is terrible. My sister went there today to buy a coat for her dog. It looked like it would fit in the store, but then it was much too tight at home (I live next door). We went to return it, and they refused to give us a refund (as the law stipulates). They gave us a voucher instead. As soon as I redeem the voucher, I'm never going back.

Today I bought food for my hamster, and when I opened the package at home, I found it was full of bugs. I understand it's not the store staff's fault, but I do think it's important that the condition of the products be checked before they are put on sale, as it can affect the health of pets. I've attached a video as proof, and I hope you can take measures to prevent this from happening again.

Thank you so much, Anna, for your review! 🌟 We're delighted to hear that your experience at Mascotas1000 Concepción Arenal was positive. We'd love to see you back in store soon! 🐶🐱

Remember that with our customer card you can enjoy exclusive discounts and many more benefits. We look forward to seeing you! 💳😊
Great variety of products and very good service

We went to buy a collar for our dog. The saleswoman was very helpful and let us try them on to help us decide. The problem is that it's incredibly hot inside the store, and we ended up sweating from putting collars on and taking them off. I don't think it's normal for it to be that hot inside; they only have a small fan at the entrance. If we were hot for just 20 minutes, I can't imagine how hot the saleswomen must be working in there all day. The low rating is because of the unbearable heat inside.

Great! It's not the shop itself, but the sales assistants. Right now, Alexandra is working there. Let's hope she doesn't change because she really gives great advice about my dog's diet. It's worth mentioning that all the sales assistants who have worked here have been very nice.
Hello, it's 10:24 and the store is closed?
A great shop and especially the service from Erica.

Hi, I know that store very well, always 100% recommended. Erika is an excellent worker and knows the products very well, a true professional. Don't hesitate to ask; she'll advise you on the best, as always. I wish every store had someone like her. Thank you for recommending Psittacus high-energy feed for my bird; it's working wonderfully for him.

Thank you so much for your review, Miguel! ⭐ We're delighted to hear that your experience at Mascotas 1000 Barcelona Concepción Arenal was positive. 😊 If you need anything for your pets, we'd be happy to help! 🐾 …
We've been buying our dog's food here for years, and it's been the best he's ever had: tasty, easy to digest, and excellent value for money. …
I'm a regular customer and I can say that Erika's service has always been excellent. She's very attentive to all my orders, knows her products well, and is very efficient. …
